mapper.select: select status, count(1) as cnt from brm_equipment group by status

select e.equip_id as equipId, e.equip_name as equipName, e.equip_type as equipType, e.model as model, c.classroom_name as classroomName, m.last_repair_date as lastRepairDate, case when m.last_repair_date is null then null else datediff(curdate(), m.last_repair_date) end as daysSince from brm_equipment e left join brm_classroom c on e.classroom_id = c.classroom_id left join ( select equip_id, max(repair_date) as last_repair_date from brm_equipment_maintenance group by equip_id ) m on m.equip_id = e.equip_id where e.status = '0' and (m.last_repair_date is null or datediff(curdate(), m.last_repair_date) >= #{dueDays}) order by daysSince desc, e.equip_name asc

select t.teacher_id as teacherId, t.teacher_name as teacherName, t.teacher_code as teacherCode, d.dept_name as deptName, count(distinct o.course_id) as courseCount, count(distinct s.offering_id) as offeringCount, count(s.schedule_id) as scheduleCount, coalesce(sum(case when s.schedule_id is not null then (s.end_period - s.start_period + 1) else 0 end), 0) as weeklySessions from brm_teacher t left join brm_department d on t.dept_id = d.dept_id left join tpm_course_offering o on o.teacher_id = t.teacher_id and o.del_flag = '0' and o.semester_id = #{semesterId} left join tpm_schedule s on s.offering_id = o.offering_id and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' where t.status = '0' group by t.teacher_id, t.teacher_name, t.teacher_code, d.dept_name order by weeklySessions desc, t.teacher_name asc
